artists.biography: Anneke van Giersbergen (born March 8, 1973) was the singer in the Dutch band The Gathering from 1995 to 2007 when she announced her departure, summer 2007. She has since formed Agua de Annique with whom she released new songs in the fall of 2007. She has also worked with Devin Townsend Project, Danny Cavanagh & Anathema, Lawn, The Farmer Boys , Ayreon, Napalm Death, Globus, Moonspell, Giant Squid, Novembers Doom, Wetton/Downes, Maiden United and she has also done a live guest performance for Within Temptation. Her new album "The Darkest Skies Are The Brightest" is out now. Dianne van Giersbergen and Anneke van Giersbergen are both Dutch symphonic metal singers with the same last name. They are not related, but share a common last name, which is also the name of a small village in the Netherlands. They are both known for their strong vocal abilities and have achieved notable success in the symphonic metal scene. Read more on Last.fm. perplexity.description:
In Your Room is the third studio album by Agua de Annique, released on October 30, 2009. Following the commercial success of her previous efforts Air (2007) and Pure Air (2009), this album marked a shift toward a more accessible and direct sound. Produced by Michel Schoots, formerly of Urban Dance Squad, the record demonstrates van Giersbergen's intention to create a cohesive, tightly-produced work that reflected a lighter emotional place in her life compared to her earlier solo material.

Musically, In Your Room blends indie pop sensibilities with rock elements, maintaining the melancholic undertones characteristic of van Giersbergen's work while embracing a more straightforward songwriting approach. The album features twelve tracks including "Wonder," "Pearly," and "Home Again," showcasing her distinctive vocal presence across varied compositional styles. The production choices and song structures prioritize accessibility without sacrificing the artistic depth expected from the former Gathering frontwoman.

The album achieved moderate commercial success, charting at number 31 on the Dutch charts, a respectable showing that demonstrated continued audience interest in van Giersbergen's solo endeavors. In Your Room solidified her position as a solo artist capable of evolving her sound while maintaining artistic credibility, establishing a foundation for her continued work in the years following its release.
